conflicts.reason: Nintendo JP prints 約1.55kg; Nintendo UK's (1.6 kg) is a coarser figure beside its 3.5-pound value.

notes: BODY: Nintendo JP 主な仕様: 縦 (vertical, i.e. height) 46, 横 (horizontal, i.e. width) 172, 奥行き (depth) 268.5 mm, '（突起部を除く）' → excludes_projections true. The console as it lies flat. Nintendo UK gives the same body in inches ('Approximately 1.8 inches high, 10.6 inches deep and 6.75 inches long.'); not a conflict after reading, not converted.
MASS CONFLICT: Nintendo JP '約1.55kg' (1550 g) vs Nintendo UK '(1.6 kg)' (with 'Approximately 3.5 pounds'). JP chosen: finer precision; the UK figure reads as a rounding of its own pound value.
media: slot-loading drive (スロットローディング方式) → disc_slot 1; the US manual's 'Disc Slot' agrees.

ports: Nintendo of America's Wii U Operations Manual (archived copy of nintendo.com/consumer/downloads/manual-nintendo-wiiu-operations-english.pdf, born-digital text via pypdf), 'System Components' front/side/back: SD Card Slot → sd_card 1; USB Ports → usb_a 4 (count from Nintendo JP 'USB 2.0端子×4 (前面 2、背面 2)'; the connector type is our reading of the kind, flagged); AC Adapter Connector → power_in 1; AV Multi Out Connector → multi_av_out 1; HDMI Port → hdmi 1; Sensor Bar Connector has no §3 kind (not filed). No controller ports (wireless controllers).
controls: POWER Button → power_button; EJECT Button → eject_button; SYNC Button has no §3 kind; no reset button in the components list.
Premium (32 GB) and Basic (8 GB) sets share this body per the same JP page. external_ids: Wikidata Q56942 ('Wii U'); igdb_platform 'wiiu' is P5795 on that item.
